description: Independent C reconstruction of the Q7 fixed-point Q13 3x3 matrix leaf; freestanding compilation and bounded original-MIPS caller equivalence.

arithmetic.input: Three O32 pointer arguments a0/a1/a2 for output, left and right. Each input is nine row-major signed 16-bit elements, each output element is the low 16 bits.
arithmetic.computation: For each row/column, original MIPS multiplies signed halfwords, takes the low 32-bit accumulator, adds 0x1000 modulo 2^32, applies logical right shift 13, and stores a halfword.
arithmetic.alias: The original snapshots both inputs in stack RAM before the first output store. The C reconstruction delays all destination writes until all dot products are evaluated, giving the same halfword-aligned RAM result even for partial overlap.
arithmetic.scope: This is coefficient preparation, with no camera, image pixels, IO buffers or hardware programming in the replay.

abi.original: The E03 and E04 carrier ELF headers have class 32, little-endian, machine 8 and e_flags 0x70001001. These flags specify MIPS32r2-family, O32, NOREORDER. These stripped carrier headers have no section table to declare an FP ABI. The tested leaf takes integer pointers and has no COP1 operation.
abi.rebuilt: Zig 0.15.2 / Clang 20.1.2 emits an ELF32 little-endian ET_REL object with the same e_flags. Its .MIPS.abiflags explicitly marks ISA 32 revision 2, 32-bit GPRs and 32-bit FP registers with hard-float ABI attribute 1. Only .text.q7_matrix_mul_q13 is used, with zero text relocations and no unresolved imports; .rel.pdr targets a non-loaded procedure-descriptor section.
abi.isolation: The original and reconstructed leaf are replayed at 0x8041bc90 in two separate in-memory projects. Only 164 bytes of a 236-byte bounded original function region change. The remaining 72 bytes are unchanged and excluded from the rebuilt execution guard.
abi.guards: The replay enforces executable intervals and allowed data reads/writes, compares ordered destination halfword stores and the surrounding memory, preserves the stack pointer and callee-saved GPR/FPR canaries, and checks the return address.
abi.machine_state_limit: HI/LO differ in this VEX case. Equality is limited to checked output, memory and ABI observables; not whole-machine state or hardware behavior.

caller.selected: Four synthetic configuration objects with styles 0, 1, 2 and Color Space values 0/1; non-null fifth output pointer, optional second pointer null.
caller.action: Execute from original MakeColorMatrix entry to its actual return. The caller uses real Q8 hue rotation, lookup tables, Q13 matrix calls and subsequent transforms. Observation-only state.inspect hooks; no function stubs or behavior substitutions.
caller.match: Every caller case compares the actual leaf call sites, arguments and input hashes, ordered nonstack store addresses/sizes/values, full guarded output buffers and scratch, callee-preserved registers, and the fifth stack argument.
caller.bounds: These settings reach 14 Q13 calls for sRGB and 15 for AdobeRGB, including in-place calls. This does not exercise all picture-style or optional second-object branches.

replay.scope: Two code images use the same verified Q7 ELF snapshot. The second changes only the selected leaf text at its original address in host memory. The leaf and four original MakeColorMatrix calls execute with VEX and synthetic RAM, using observation-only state.inspect hooks and no function stubs or behavior substitutions. No device is used.

machine_state_probe.scope: HI/LO differ in this VEX case. Equality is limited to checked output, memory and ABI observables; not whole-machine state or hardware behavior.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.

evidence.role: Signed multiply, low word, rounding, shift and halfword output
Original caller and both color-space routes

reproduction: tools/check_recompiled_numeric.py exposes validate_report(document['replay']) for standard-library metadata and mathematical reference checks.
limitations: The C checker recompiles and replays one arithmetic leaf. The separate package checker inserts that pinned text into original fixed slots and verifies full software decoding; neither runs on a camera.

The tested external contract is aligned writable/readable RAM, O32 pointer arguments, and a bounded original caller. The C implementation need not reproduce original instruction scheduling or stack contents.
The code section is position-independent within this no-call/no-data leaf and has no executable relocation. The experiment does not establish placement rules for other compiled code.

The archive digest is the official Zig index entry. The already-installed compiler executable, source, resulting object/text and original inputs are pinned locally; the toolchain support directory is read-only and was not individually hashed.

HI/LO differ in the positive-wrap/distinct VEX probe: original=(0,0xc0000000), recompiled=(0,0). The selected original MakeColorMatrix body has no MFHI/MFLO instruction; other callers, volatile GPRs, unused stack bytes and whole-machine state are not asserted equal.

comparison.scope: Compare validation categories, not ABI or camera acceptance. K-3 matrix input/output domains are disjoint; Q7 includes overlap.

package_attempt.error: recompressed payload needs 9916 bytes; slot has 9856
package_attempt.method: Existing repack_q7 token/table/slot-preserving encoder, no relocation
package_attempt.limits: A rejected attempt, no output package created; does not prove that better compression or a validated new format is impossible.

limits: Host software decoder and byte identity only; no camera hardware inflate or update acceptance.
Original tables, slots, ELF positions and file size retained; no general relocation or table regeneration.
The current fallback still requires literal codes and adequate space; unrepresentable or overflowing windows fail.
